newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WADDLE SIGNS THREE-YEAR DEAL WITH BURNLEY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WADDLE SIGNS THREE-YEAR DEAL WITH BURNLEY.

text.p: Former England international Chris Waddle signed a three-year contract as player-manager of second division club Burnley on Tuesday.
Waddle, who won 62 caps for England, was released by premier league side Sheffield Wednesday last year and spent time with Scottish club Falkirk and English clubs Bradford and Sunderland last season.
The 36-year-old midfielder replaces Adrian Heath, who has signed as Howard Kendall's assistant at Everton.
